d: When a gentlewoman is found dead with her throat torn out, the villagers blame a supernatural monster. But Sherlock Holmes, who gets drawn into the case from nearby Quebec, suspects a human murderer.
A murder mystery set on a speeding train, Holmes guards the transport of the 400-carat diamond. In Vibrant Colour!

st: The Case Of Harry Crocker
d: 'Escape artist' Crocker, escapes from the police to ask Holmes to clear him from a murder charge.

st: The Case Of Cunningham Heritage
d: Holmes invites the good doctor to their first murder investigation.

t: Sherlock Holmes: The Case of the Diamond Tooth
st: The Case of the Diamond Tooth
d: While walking along the banks of the River Thames, Watson finds a diamond tooth. The article takes on more meaning later, however, when Holmes learns that the body of a murder victim had been discovered near where Watson found the tooth.

st: The Mother Hubbard Case
d: Margaret Martini's fiancee is missing, but the trail to his whereabouts leads to 7 other murders.

st: The Case Of The Texas Cowgirl
d: Minnie, a cowgirl from a travelling western show, visits Holmes after she finds a dead body in her room.

t: Sherlock Holmes: The Case of the Impromptu Performance
st: The Case of the Impromptu Performance
d: A condemned man scheduled to hang the next day uses his last request to ask Sherlock Holmes to prove his innocence of the murder for which he is about to be executed.

st: The Case Of The Laughing Mummy
d: Holmes uncovers a serious mystery when helping one of Watson's old friends.

t: Sherlock Holmes: The Case of the Unlucky Gambler
st: The Case of the Unlucky Gambler
d: A young boy shows up at Baker Street, asking for Holmes' help in finding his missing father.

t: Sherlock Holmes: The Case of the Tyrant's Daughter
st: The Case of the Tyrant's Daughter
d: A chemist is accused of the murder of his fiancé's stepfather, who was determined to keep the two apart.

st: The Case Of The French Interpreter
d: A French interpreter urgently needs the detective, as criminals try to take him to their hide out.

st: The Case Of The Imposter Mystery
d: While on holiday, the detectives are impersonated for a profit.
Sherlock Holmes investigates a series of so-called \\"pajama suicides\\". He knows the female villain behind them is as cunning as Moriarty and as venomous as a spider.

st: The Case Of The Violent Suitor
d: An advice columnist turns to Holmes when a man badly beats him and threatens a young woman's life.
Sherlock Holmes sets out to discover why a trio of murderous villains, including a dangerously attractive female, are desperate to obtain three unassuming and inexpensive little music boxes.

t: Sherlock Holmes: The Case of the Neurotic Detective
st: The Case of the Neurotic Detective
d: Watson believes Holmes is a criminal mastermind, but all is not as it seems.

t: Sherlock Holmes: The Case of the Pennsylvannia Gun
st: The Case of the Pennsylvannia Gun
d: Holmes and Watson travel to Sussex to investigate the murder of Squire Douglas, who was shot to death in a sealed-up castle, with only two apparent suspects.
Holmes is recruited to escort the heir to a European throne safely back to his homeland after his father's assassination.

st: The Case Of The Thistle Killer
d: Sherlock Holmes helps to track down a killer who leaves clues next to the women he kills.

st: The Case Of The Night Train Riddle
d: Holmes investigates a missing boy that vanishes on a train after he and his father have a fight.

st: The Case Of The Greystone Inscription
d: When a fiancé disappears, Holmes finds evidence at his home to take to the castle he was studying.

st: The Case Of Lady Beryl
d: Visiting a home of high nobility, a businessman is murdered.

st: The Case Of The Belligerent Ghost
d: Watson claims that he was hit in the eye by Albert Higgins a half hour after he had watched him die.

t: Sherlock Holmes: The Case of the Baker Street Bachelors
st: The Case of the Baker Street Bachelors
d: A political leader is being blackmailed, and to find the blackmailers, Holmes and Watson join a marriage bureau. However, things don't go quite as planned, and Holmes winds up getting arrested and thrown in jail.

st: The Case Of The Shoeless Engineer
d: Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson treat an injured man after a fierce encounter that he barely escapes.
